Title: Mark single attendance as present for valid employee and date
Description: Verify that marking attendance as present for a valid employeeId and date returns success with correct attendance record
Pre-Conditions: Employee with ID 1 exists in the system
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body {"employeeId":1,"absent":false,"date":"2025-01-01"}
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains attendance record with employeeId=1, date=2025-01-01, absent=false
Expected Result: Attendance record saved with absent=false for employeeId=1 on 2025-01-01, response status 200

Title: Mark single attendance as absent for valid employee and date
Description: Verify that marking attendance as absent for a valid employeeId and date returns success with correct attendance record
Pre-Conditions: Employee with ID 2 exists in the system
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body {"employeeId":2,"absent":true,"date":"2025-01-01"}
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains attendance record with employeeId=2, date=2025-01-01, absent=true
Expected Result: Attendance record saved with absent=true for employeeId=2 on 2025-01-01, response status 200

Title: Mark single attendance with missing employeeId
Description: Verify that marking attendance without employeeId returns bad request error
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body {"absent":false,"date":"2025-01-02"}
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 with error message indicating employeeId and absent are required

Title: Mark single attendance with invalid employeeId (-1)
Description: Verify that marking attendance with invalid employeeId returns success or error depending on service validation
Pre-Conditions: Employee with ID -1 does not exist
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body {"employeeId":-1,"absent":false,"date":"2025-01-03"}
Verify response status is 200 OK or appropriate error if validation exists
If success, verify attendance record created with employeeId=-1 and absent=false
Expected Result: Depending on implementation, either attendance record created or error returned; no bad request from controller

Title: Mark single attendance with future date boundary
Description: Verify that marking attendance on a far future date is accepted and saved correctly
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body {"employeeId":3,"absent":false,"date":"2099-12-31"}
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify attendance record saved with date 2099-12-31
Expected Result: Attendance record saved successfully with future date, response status 200

Title: Mark batch attendance with multiple valid entries
Description: Verify that batch marking attendance with multiple valid attendance records returns correct counts and saved records
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with body containing attendance for employeeId=1 (present) and employeeId=2 (absent) on 2025-01-01
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains savedCount=2, presentCount=1, absentCount=1
Verify savedRecords contains both attendance records with correct absent flags
Verify invalidEntries list is empty
Expected Result: Batch attendance saved successfully with correct counts and no invalid entries

Title: Mark batch attendance with some invalid entries
Description: Verify that batch marking attendance with some entries missing employeeId or absent flags returns partial success and lists invalid entries
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with body containing one valid attendance (employeeId=1, absent=false) and one invalid attendance (missing employeeId)
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify savedCount=1, presentCount=1, absentCount=0
Verify invalidEntries list is empty because invalid entry has no employeeId
Verify savedRecords contains only the valid attendance record
Expected Result: Valid attendance saved, invalid entry skipped, invalidEntries list empty, response 200

Title: Mark batch attendance with invalid employeeId in one entry
Description: Verify that batch marking attendance with one entry having invalid employeeId (-1) is processed and invalid employeeId is listed
Pre-Conditions: Employee with ID -1 does not exist
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with body containing one valid attendance (employeeId=1, absent=false) and one with employeeId=-1
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify savedCount=2 (assuming service saves even invalid employeeId), presentCount and absentCount correct
Verify invalidEntries list contains -1 if that entry is considered invalid due to missing absent or employeeId null
Verify savedRecords contains both records
Expected Result: Both records processed, invalidEntries list empty because employeeId present, response 200

Title: Mark batch attendance with empty payload
Description: Verify that batch marking attendance with empty list returns bad request error
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with empty array [] as body
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'payload is empty'
Expected Result: Response status 400 with error message indicating payload is empty

Title: Mark batch attendance with future date boundary
Description: Verify that batch marking attendance with future date boundary is accepted and saved correctly
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with one attendance record for employeeId=3, absent=false, date=2099-12-31
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify savedCount=1, presentCount=1, absentCount=0
Verify savedRecords contains the attendance record with date 2099-12-31
Expected Result: Attendance record saved successfully with future date, response status 200

Title: Get all employees successfully
Description: Verify that the GET /api/employe endpoint returns a list of all employees
Pre-Conditions: At least one employee exists in the database
Test Steps: Send a GET request to /api/employe
Verify the response status code is 200 OK
Verify the response body contains a list of employee objects
Expected Result: Response status 200 with a JSON array of employee objects

Title: Get employee by valid ID
Description: Verify that GET /api/employe/{id} returns the employee details when a valid existing ID is provided
Test Steps: Send a GET request to /api/employe/1
Verify the response status code is 200 OK
Verify the response body contains the employee details with ID 1
Expected Result: Response status 200 with employee object for ID 1

Title: Get employee by non-existing ID returns empty employee
Description: Verify that GET /api/employe/{id} returns an empty employee object when the ID does not exist
Test Steps: Send a GET request to /api/employe/9999
Verify the response status code is 200 OK
Verify the response body contains an empty employee object (default values)
Expected Result: Response status 200 with empty employee object

Title: Create a new employee with valid data
Description: Verify that POST /api/employee creates a new employee when valid data is provided
Pre-Conditions: API is available and database is accessible
Test Steps: Send a POST request to /api/employee with body {"name":"Aman Gupt","role":"Developer","absent":false}
Verify the response status code is 200 OK or 201 Created
Verify the employee is saved in the database with the provided details
Expected Result: Employee is created successfully and persisted

Title: Create a new employee with empty fields
Description: Verify that POST /api/employee accepts empty or missing fields in the request body
Test Steps: Send a POST request to /api/employee with body {"name":"","role":"","absent":null}
Verify the response status code is 200 OK or 201 Created
Verify the employee is saved with empty or null fields
Expected Result: Employee is created with empty or null fields without error

Title: Update existing employee with valid data
Description: Verify that PUT /api/employee/{id} updates the employee details when valid data and existing ID are provided
Test Steps: Send a PUT request to /api/employee/1 with body {"name":"John Doe","role":"Manager","absent":false}
Verify the response status code is 200 OK
Verify the response body contains updated employee details
Verify the employee data is updated in the database
Expected Result: Employee details updated successfully with status 200

Title: Update non-existing employee returns 404
Description: Verify that PUT /api/employee/{id} returns 404 Not Found when the employee ID does not exist
Test Steps: Send a PUT request to /api/employee/9999 with body {"name":"John Doe","role":"Manager","absent":false}
Verify the response status code is 404 Not Found
Expected Result: Response status 404 Not Found

Title: Update employee with missing name field
Description: Verify that PUT /api/employee/{id} updates employee when name is empty but other fields are valid
Test Steps: Send a PUT request to /api/employee/4 with body {"name":"","role":"Developer","absent":false}
Verify the response status code is 200 OK
Verify the employee's name is updated to empty string
Expected Result: Employee updated with empty name field

Title: Update employee with missing role field
Description: Verify that PUT /api/employee/{id} updates employee when role is empty but other fields are valid
Test Steps: Send a PUT request to /api/employee/8888 with body {"name":"Meera Singh","role":"","absent":false}
Verify the response status code is 200 OK
Verify the employee's role is updated to empty string
Expected Result: Employee updated with empty role field

Title: Update employee with long name boundary value
Description: Verify that PUT /api/employee/{id} updates employee with a very long name string
Test Steps: Send a PUT request to /api/employee/0 with body {"name":"VeryLongNameVeryLongNameVeryLongName","role":"Senior Engineer","absent":false}
Verify the response status code is 200 OK
Verify the employee's name is updated to the long string
Expected Result: Employee updated successfully with long name

Title: Delete existing employee by ID
Description: Verify that DELETE /api/employee/{id} deletes the employee when a valid existing ID is provided
Test Steps: Send a DELETE request to /api/employee/1
Verify the response status code is 200 OK or 204 No Content
Verify the employee with ID 1 is removed from the database
Expected Result: Employee deleted successfully

Title: Delete non-existing employee by ID
Description: Verify that DELETE /api/employee/{id} does not fail when deleting a non-existing employee ID
Test Steps: Send a DELETE request to /api/employee/9999
Verify the response status code is 200 OK or 204 No Content
Verify no error is returned
Expected Result: No error and successful response status
